items.heading: Shuwa
details: Key ingredients: lamb, spice paste, banana leaf
Rub lamb generously with a paste of garlic, chili and spices.
Wrap the meat tightly in banana leaves.
Bury and slow-cook in an underground pit oven for a full day.
Unwrap the tender, smoky meat and serve with rice.

items.heading: Omani Halwa
details: Key ingredients: sugar, ghee, cardamom, saffron, nuts
Cook sugar syrup with cardamom and saffron until fragrant.
Gradually stir in starch to thicken the mixture.
Add ghee bit by bit, stirring constantly until glossy and elastic.
Pour into a dish, scatter with nuts and let cool before slicing.

items.heading: Majboos
details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.
Prepare and cut the main ingredients.
Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.
